FROM (
    SELECT f."Id", f."ApprovedByUserId", f."ApprovedDate", f."ApprovedQuantity", f."Command", f."CreatedAt", f."CurrentMileage", f."DispensedByUserId", f."DispensedDate", f."FuelType", f."Purpose", f."Reason", f."Remarks", f."RequestDate", f."RequestNumber", f."RequestedQuantity", f."RequesterName", f."RequiredDate", f."Status", f."UpdatedAt", f."UserId", f."VehicleId", f."Zone"
    FROM "FuelRequests" AS f
    WHERE f."UserId" = @__user_UserId_0
    ORDER BY f."CreatedAt" DESC

ORDER BY t."CreatedAt" DESC
